 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Before potentially winning the first Ballon d'Or of his career on Monday, Harry Kane is doing what he loves most: scoring goals.
 The Bayern star scored from the penalty spot against Arsenal in the 61st minute after a handball by Arsenal's Timber. Kane's goal also kept an incredible streak going.
 The Englishman has now scored in ten consecutive Champions League games. Only Cristiano Ronaldo (11) has scored in more consecutive matches in the competition's history. Wow.
